lanes.summary: Review completed. All components match the spec. No correctness defects were found. IQ tables spot-checked successfully against ggml-common.h. Tests are honest and refusal sites are unweakened.

findings.claim: off-by-one in the CtaIdY offset or gamma indexing
findings.fix: No defect. CtaIdY computes `row_idx = seq_idx * num_heads + head_idx` which is correct, and gamma rightly omits the batch stride because it is shared.

findings.claim: wrong head count for K (num_kv_heads) vs Q
findings.fix: No defect. `batched_per_head_rmsnorm_into` correctly uses `num_kv_heads` for K.

findings.claim: RoPE ordering
findings.fix: No defect. Applied correctly between QKV bias and RoPE phase.

findings.claim: in-place aliasing hazards
findings.fix: No hazard. The warp reduction sum is computed entirely before any thread writes to the output pointer.

findings.claim: recorded arg_data pointer list matching the launch args
findings.fix: No defect. `vec![ptr_input, ptr_output, ptr_gamma]` matches the 3 kernel parameters exactly.

findings.claim: KV-cache poisoning by the F2 batched probe
findings.fix: No defect. `reset_kv_cache_gpu` is explicitly called both before and after `f2_gpu_batched_logits`.

findings.claim: the FP16 retry mutating gpu_profile for the rest of the process
findings.fix: No defect. It is an intentional precision fallback per model-replica to avoid repeating FP8 generation failures.

findings.fix: No fix required; implementation is correct.

findings.claim: batched_qkv_rope_phase correctly uses num_heads for Q and num_kv_heads for K, and applies per-head RMSNorm between bias addition and RoPE
findings.fix: No fix required; ordering and head counts are correct.

findings.claim: In-place aliasing of input and output buffers in batched_per_head_rmsnorm is race-free because pass 1 reduction completes before pass 2 in-place strided write
findings.fix: No fix required; in-place operation is safe.

KV-cache poisoning is prevented by explicit reset_kv_cache_gpu() calls before and after every probe and FP16 retry branch
findings.fix: No fix required; cache is reset on all paths.

findings.claim: FP16 retry mutates only the local model instance's gpu_profile (cuda_model.executor.gpu_profile.fp8_prefill = false), not global or process state
findings.fix: No fix required; behavior is instance-scoped and intentional.

findings.fix: No fix required; refusal sites are preserved.

findings.fix: No fix required; diff scope is clean.
